main_text.p: [illegible, ~6 letters]bus consistit, quæque insuper princi-pes sunt Sanitatis & morborum caus-æ, à quibus homo semper atque in omni vitæ statu omnique ætate affici-tur, ex quibus præterea omnia com-ponuntur alimenta & medicamen-ta, quorum itidem præcipuæ facul-tates, sunt salsum, acidum, amarum & spiritus, uti præter Hippocra-tem omnesque Heroas, qui cum ipso veritatis vestigia presso pede sequun-tur, Ratio & Experientia prote-guantur; omninò sequitur D. Le Vasseur toti Antiquitati, rationi, & sensui communi contradicere, dum primen vocat, Sylvium, Practicum, cujus est Sanitatem protegere, mor-bosque propellere, in sua Praxi iden-tidem eorum facere mentionem, sine quibus nec Sanitas conservari aut præ-servari, nec morbi profligari, neque symptomata mitigari possunt. Certè primen est, & capitale, non semper illa attendere, agyrtarum more so-lis

page.notes: Scan is cropped at the left edge, so the first words of each line are cut off; the restorations in brackets and the initial fragments are uncertain. Several words are doubtful, e.g. "primen" (likely "primum") and "guantur" (likely "gantur"), and the initial word of the first line is illegible. The catchword "lis" is the first word of the following page.
